question: In India, census is conducted under the provisions of the Census Act _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Census Act 1948:-**

 
 
• It is an Act of the Parliament of India that provides for the taking of a census in India or any part thereof whenever it may consider it necessary or desirable so to do.
 
• The Act was enacted in 1948, and it has been amended several times since then.
 
• The Census Act, 1948 is a very important piece of legislation, as it provides for the collection of data on the population of India.
 
• This data is used for a variety of purposes, including planning for development, allocating resources, and tracking demographic changes.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The census provides valuable information on population** size, growth rate, literacy rate**, and other **demographic and socio-economic data**. 
 
• The first census under this act was conducted in **1951.**
